open_questions: Access blocked: uaelegislation.gov.ae returned HTTP 403 to every request (WebFetch and direct). moj.gov.ae returned 'Request Rejected'. elaws.moj.gov.ae, u.ae, tdra.gov.ae, uaecabinet.ae, dc.gov.ae and dlp.dubai.gov.ae were unreachable or refused. The web-search quota was exhausted before alternative official copies could be located. No federal text could be verified, so every field is null.

Federal Decree-Law No. 35 of 2022 promulgating the Law of Evidence in Civil and Commercial Transactions: the articles on expertise (الخبرة), covering appointment, mission, the expert's oath, report contents, objections, recusal and fees, are unverified. So are the provisions on electronic or digital evidence (الدليل الإلكتروني).

Federal Law No. 7 of 2023 Regulating Expertise before Judicial Authorities: registration of experts, duties, prohibitions, the expert's oath formula, disciplinary penalties and any criminal penalty are unverified. Not confirmed whether it repealed Federal Law No. 7 of 2012.

Federal Decree-Law No. 38 of 2022 (Criminal Procedure Law): articles on the use of experts by judicial police, the Public Prosecution and the courts, the expert's oath before the prosecutor or court, and report requirements are unverified.
Federal Decree-Law No. 31 of 2021 (Crimes and Penalties Law): the article(s) punishing a false expert opinion or report, and the maximum penalty, are unverified.

Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services: the term for the qualified signature (التوقيع الإلكتروني المعتمد or similar), qualified electronic time-stamps, and their presumptions or legal effect are unverified.

No UAE national adoption or official guidance on ISO/IEC 27037/27041/27042/27043 or ISO/IEC 17025 for digital forensic reports was verified (Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology / UAE standards; Dubai Police and Abu Dhabi Police forensic laboratory requirements).

Abu Dhabi Judicial Department (adjd.gov.ae, reachable) publishes bilingual judicial expertise forms: a final/preliminary expert report form with sections Mission, Disputed Claim, Expert Procedures, Case Analysis and Responding to objections, plus a minutes-of-expertise form. These are local Abu Dhabi forms (2020 edition, commercial court) and were not used as federal sources. Check whether they reflect Federal Law No. 7 of 2023.
Legal family 'mixed' (civil law with Islamic law elements) is a general classification, not taken from a cited source.
